statement: let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); let primes := fun x : ℕ => (Finset.Ioc x ((2*x)^2+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ p^100000 ≤ (2*x)^132301); ∃ X : ℕ, ∀ x ≥ X, (∑ p ∈ primes x, ((roots 1 p).card : ℝ) * Real.log (p : ℝ)/p) ≤ (2/5 : ℝ)*Real.log (x : ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0008 · 无条件控制整个中段的根加权素数调和和
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0008 · Bound the root-weighted prime harmonic sum unconditionally

brief.zh: 已知定理的推论。对固定模 4 的素数定理做 Abel 求和，根加权和除以 log x 后趋于 0.32301。
brief.en: Apply Abel summation to the prime number theorem in the fixed progression 1 mod 4. The root-weighted sum divided by log x tends to 0.32301.
